description: Public-safe synthetic interrupted-operation fixtures for the operator-mcp M3 H3 ten-scenario lifecycle recovery matrix (OPM-6.1 / OPM-6.4, AC OPM-3). Every scenario references a workspace_id from workspaces.json (fixture-only, synthetic). Each scenario's `expected` block is the acceptance oracle tests/unit/test_operator_operation_service.py's H3-01..H3-10 tests assert against -- action_id/effect_kind/effect_ref values here are load-bearing, not decorative: tests build their ActionSpec sequence FROM `actions` and compare real persisted receipts against `expected`.

scenarios.name: interrupted_after_manifest_write
scenarios.description: Process loss immediately after the operation manifest is durably committed, before run_actions is ever invoked. Resume must start at index 0 -- identical to a fresh first execution.

scenarios.name: interrupted_mid_attempt
scenarios.description: An attempt is created (attempt_adapter.create_attempt) but the process is lost before that attempt's action produces any action_receipt. Resume must mint a NEW attempt (never resurrect or reuse the stale one) and execute every action from index 0.

scenarios.name: interrupted_after_effect_receipt
scenarios.description: Action 0's action_receipt AND effect_receipt are durably committed, but the checkpoint that would normally follow never happens. resolve_resume_point (from real persisted rows, not checkpoint) must resume at index 1 without replaying action 0.

scenarios.name: interrupted_before_terminal_receipt
scenarios.description: Every action's action_receipt, effect_receipt, and post-action checkpoint are durably committed, but finalize_terminal_receipt is never reached. A fresh run_or_replay call must reconcile and finalize the SAME terminal receipt an uninterrupted run would have produced, with zero re-execution.

scenarios.name: interrupted_during_cancel
scenarios.description: A cancellation request is durably persisted and action 0 completes (action_receipt + effect_receipt committed), but the process is lost before the CANCELED checkpoint/terminal receipt is written. Resume on a fresh instance must observe the durable cancellation at the next safe point and finalize status=canceled with exactly one completed action -- action 1 and action 2 must never run.

scenarios.name: exact_retry_idempotency_after_completion
scenarios.description: An operation runs to completion, then run_or_replay is called again with is_replay=True. The retry must return the IDENTICAL terminal receipt with zero new action/effect receipts and zero re-execution of any action.

scenarios.name: cancel_before_first_action
scenarios.description: Cancellation is durably requested before any action runs. run_actions observes it at the very first safe point: zero actions execute, zero effects are produced, and the terminal receipt is status=canceled with action_count_completed=0.

scenarios.name: resume_after_cancel_is_refused
scenarios.description: An operation reaches a terminal status=canceled receipt (via the same shape as H3-07). A subsequent resume_operation call, presented with a FRESH confirmation, must resolve to outcome=already_terminal (never re-executing, never minting a new attempt) and return the EXACT canceled terminal receipt.

scenarios.name: duplicate_suppression_on_idempotency_key_retry
scenarios.description: An operation completes. A SECOND, freshly-minted confirmation is then presented under the SAME (workspace_id, idempotency_key, canonical_input_digest) -- consume_and_create_operation must resolve this to exact_replay against the SAME operation_id, and run_or_replay(is_replay=True) must add zero new action_receipt/effect_receipt rows (no duplicate source card, claim, or candidate).

scenarios.name: full_convergence_uninterrupted_vs_interrupted_after_effect_receipt
scenarios.description: The comprehensive D6 convergence check: a control operation runs five actions straight through; a twin operation is interrupted after action 2's effect_receipt (no checkpoint) and resumed on a fresh service instance. The two operations' canonical (effect_kind, effect_ref) sets, action_receipt/effect_receipt counts, and normalized terminal receipts must be set-equal / identical.
